log.hypothesis: Baseline of the unedited model: soft1e-4 (photon far below the training energy cut) should give a larger response than soft1e-3, and soft3e-3 (above the cut) a smaller one.
Activations with a 1e-4 photon added: the added token's embedding should be atypical (large norm or unusual direction), and the summary-token change should already appear in early blocks.
Clean reference activations for the same 256 jets, to diff against the soft1e-4 capture.
Block-wise growth of the summary-token difference between soft1e-4 and clean; I expect a roughly steady growth across blocks, driven by attention to the out-of-distribution soft token.
Block-wise growth of the summary-token difference between soft1e-4 and clean; I expect a roughly steady growth across blocks, driven by attention to the out-of-distribution soft token.
The 1e-3 photon should use the same mechanism as 1e-4: large attention from the summary tokens in block 7 head 6, and a soft-token representation at block 6 along the same direction as for 1e-4.

Most of the soft-photon response goes through block-7 head-6 attention from the summary tokens to the soft token. A rank-1 key edit along an LDA soft-token direction lowers that logit by about 12, which should remove most of the response at little side cost.
In softened-fragmentation jets, block-7 head 6 should also attend to soft charged particles and to soft neutrals near threshold, which is why the LDA key edit changed P_ref.

Logits on 512 clean jets, their P versions, P minus neutrals below the training energy cut, and P minus neutrals with pT fraction under 2e-3. Comparing the original model with edit e1 shows which variant behaves like P_ref, whose response e1 reduced by 26%.

Logits on 512 clean jets, their P versions, P minus neutrals below the training energy cut, and P minus neutrals with pT fraction under 2e-3. Comparing the original model with edit e1 shows which variant behaves like P_ref, whose response e1 reduced by 26%.

Inputs to the block-6 MLP (recovered from fc1 pre-activations) should give a linear soft-neutral score that a single GELU unit can threshold, and classifier queries for designing the ghost sign pattern.
P minus neutrals below pT fraction 1e-3, 1.5e-3 or 3e-3. The e1 response ratio should rise with the cut; the cut that gives about 0.74 (the oracle's P_ref value) points to P_ref's definition.
P minus neutrals below pT fraction 1e-3, 1.5e-3 or 3e-3. The e1 response ratio should rise with the cut; the cut that gives about 0.74 (the oracle's P_ref value) points to P_ref's definition.

A repurposed block-6 MLP unit gates on a soft-neutral LDA score (threshold 0.4) and writes 25*sigma into the residual, so flagged tokens become a saturated ghost that every block-7 and classifier head nearly ignores. This should cut the soft responses well below e1's level while leaving tokens below the threshold, and so P_ref, mostly untouched.

The block-1 MLP input should already separate soft neutrals linearly (the representation is closer to the raw kinematics there), so a gate placed at block 1 could make the token a ghost from block 2 on.

A gate on dead unit 17 of block 1 (step gate, beta 1000, theta 0.15) turns soft neutrals into a saturated ghost from block 2 on, with sigma tuned jointly for blocks 2-7 and the classifier. Cutting the leakage through blocks 2-6 should beat e2.
Diffusion-noised clean jets (t=0.2/0.5/0.85), run at time 0, give tokens that the block-1 gate wrongly flags. This explains e3's generator drift, and they can serve as negatives in the gate fit.
Block-3/4 MLP inputs, to build a gate that is placed earlier than block 6 (smaller target error) but late enough that the time token at t>0 keeps it from firing during generation.

A step gate on unit 116 of block 4 (theta 0.18) makes soft neutrals a ghost from block 5 on. It should land between e2 and e3 on the soft ratios, and at t>0 the time token should have changed the block-4 representation enough that generator drift stays far below e3's.

Diagnostic: the block-1 gate refit with noised-jet negatives at theta 0.25 flags 20-50x fewer noised tokens than e3. If gen_drift falls a lot, noised particles caused e3's drift; if it stays near 1 at t=0.85, the gate is firing on the time token, which exists only when t>0.
e2 with a step gate (beta 1000, no GELU negative lobe) and theta 0.35 should match or beat e2 on the soft probes, with P_ref still near 0.97.
Under e2 the flagged soft token should be a saturated ghost after block 6. The summary-token difference at body.norm should fall from 1.46 to about 0.3, mostly inherited from blocks 0-6.
Under e2 the flagged soft token should be a saturated ghost after block 6. The summary-token difference at body.norm should fall from 1.46 to about 0.3, mostly inherited from blocks 0-6.
Block-5 (and block-2) MLP inputs, to build an extra gate that ghosts soft neutrals before block 6 attention, which is the largest remaining leakage step.

A step gate at block 5 (unit 230, theta 0.2) ghosts soft neutrals from block-6 attention on, removing the largest remaining leakage step, so the soft ratios should beat e2's 0.25. Generator drift is the open risk.

The block-6 gate as a step (beta 1000, theta 0.4) without the fc2-bias compensation for unit 65's mean output. That costs 128 fewer DoF; the lost mean (-0.47 * fc2 column) should shift clean logits only slightly.
e2 logits on clean, P, P minus neutrals below 1.5e-3 of jet pT, and P minus neutrals below 2e-3, to estimate the P-probe target error ratio under those threshold guesses.

Block-6 step gate whose direction is fitted on pT-fraction labels (neutral below 1.5e-3 vs above 2e-3), threshold 0.6. It should flag many more of P's very soft neutrals, lowering raw P's response further, with the soft probes like e2 and P_ref still above 0.9.
e7 logits on the P-variant pack. The P target-error ratio under the 1.5e-3-2e-3 hypotheses should fall below e2's 0.77-0.80.

Diagnostic plus a component: e3's block-1 gate at theta 0.5 flags only extreme tokens (all 1e-4 photons, almost no 1e-3 ones) and, on t=0 noised data, 0 / 0.05% / 1.9% of noised tokens. If gen_drift falls near e2's level, noised particles caused e3's drift; if it stays near 1 at t=0.85, the time token is being flagged.

Two gates: block-1 dead-unit gate at theta 1.2 ghosts only the far out-of-distribution soft neutrals (all 1e-4 photons) from block 2 on, and the e7 block-6 fraction gate handles the rest. Expect soft1e-4 near 0.08, soft1e-3 as in e7, P_ref about 0.9, and generator drift close to e7's because no noised token should pass 1.2.
e7 with the fraction gate threshold raised from 0.6 to 0.7, giving more P_ref margin (about 0.91) at a small cost in raw-P removal.
e10 (block-6 fraction gate, theta 0.7) plus the block-1 extreme gate (theta 1.2). The two act on disjoint stages, so expect e10's metrics with soft1e-4 near 0.08.

e11 plus a second dead-unit gate in block 1 (unit 7) fitted on pT-fraction labels with noised-jet negatives, threshold 1.0. It ghosts about half of the 1e-3 photons from block 2 on, so soft1e-3 should fall to about 0.18. Generator drift is the risk, since about 0.3% of noised tokens at t=0.85 pass in the t=0 approximation.

Block-1 unit-7 fraction gate at theta 1.25 plus the block-6 fraction gate (theta 0.7). Raising the theta above e12's 1.0 should cut the generator drift (e12 reached 0.18 at t=0.5) while still ghosting part of the 1e-3 photons early.

Block-1 unit-7 fraction gate at theta 1.1 plus the block-6 fraction gate (theta 0.7). Raising the theta above e12's 1.0 should cut the generator drift (e12 reached 0.18 at t=0.5) while still ghosting part of the 1e-3 photons early.
e13 plus the fc2-bias compensation of the repurposed block-6 unit's mean output (128 more DoF). Expect the same soft ratios as e13, slightly smaller clean KL, and P_ref at or a little above 0.90.
More noised-jet negatives around t=0.5, where the fraction gate's generator drift peaks, to fit a block-1 gate direction that ignores noise.

Block-1 unit-7 gate on a direction fitted with 10x-weighted noised-jet negatives (threshold 0.9), plus the block-6 fraction gate with compensation. It should catch more 1e-3 photons than e15 and, being near-orthogonal to diffusion noise, show lower generator drift than e13/e15.

Block-1 unit-7 gate on a direction fitted with 10x-weighted noised-jet negatives (threshold 1.0), plus the block-6 fraction gate with compensation. It should catch more 1e-3 photons than e15 and, being near-orthogonal to diffusion noise, show lower generator drift than e13/e15.

e17 on the P-variant pack: the P target-error ratio under the 1.5e-3-2e-3 hypotheses should be at or slightly below e7's 0.50-0.55, because the block-1 gate also removes some of P's very soft neutrals earlier.

Sparse block-6 gate: unit 65 keeps its original fc1 row plus a 48-channel fraction-LDA read scaled by 1000, and its fc2 column gets a ghost write (es1: es1 all 128 channels, es2 the 48 channels with the most block-7/classifier key leverage). With the full ghost, expect e10-like results at about 177 DoF; the partial ghost may leak more.

Sparse block-6 gate: unit 65 keeps its original fc1 row plus a 48-channel fraction-LDA read scaled by 1000, and its fc2 column gets a ghost write (es2: es1 all 128 channels, es2 the 48 channels with the most block-7/classifier key leverage). With the full ghost, expect e10-like results at about 177 DoF; the partial ghost may leak more.

es_k24: the block-6 ghost gate with a 24-channel fraction-LDA read (fc1 row of unit 65 = original + sparse change) and a full 128-channel ghost write only. Expect the same metrics as the dense counterpart at lower DoF.

fm: the block-6 ghost gate with a 24-channel fraction-LDA read (fc1 row of unit 65 = original + sparse change) and a full 128-channel ghost write, plus the block-1 extreme gate (unit 17, theta 1.2). Expect the same metrics as the dense counterpart at lower DoF.

fl: the block-6 ghost gate with a 24-channel fraction-LDA read (fc1 row of unit 65 = original + sparse change) and a full 128-channel ghost write, plus the block-1 noise-orthogonal fraction gate (unit 7, theta 1.0) and the fc2-bias compensation. Expect the same metrics as the dense counterpart at lower DoF.
